evidence.author: Kriptex
evidence.used: light paved paths with lawn and clipped dark hedges and round shrubs, black cast-iron lamp posts with globe lamps, dark wooden slatted benches, tall spruce and blue spruce plus bare broadleaf trees, a cream building with lit windows at the far edge. The photo is a close view, so it was used for furnishing and colours, not for the whole layout.

review.gaps: Close street photo so layout is generic; spruce, blue spruce and bare branching trees plus cast-iron lamps added, but benches are still small and low-poly, no weeping trees, hedges are simple blocks, pavilion is a guess.
